title: "Small RNA mapping"

This script will plot miRNA, piRNA, rRNA, and tRNA by mapping percentages. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
```

Read in data. 
```{r}
mapping <- read.csv("../data/small_RNA_mapping.csv")
```

Summarize counts by replicate
```{r}
summary_by_rep <- mapping %>%
  group_by(Replicate, Feature, Species) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # Calculate percentages within each replicate
  group_by(Replicate) %>%
  mutate(Percent = Count / sum(Count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
ggplot(summary_by_rep, aes(x = Replicate, y = Count, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single"), color = "black", size = 0.3, stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) + 
  facet_wrap(~ Species, scales = "free_x") + # Splitting by species if you add more later
  labs(
    y = "Read Count (log10 scale)",
    x = "Replicate",
    fill = "RNA Feature"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic") # Italicizes species names
  )
```


Calculate average percentages across replicates
```{r}
avg_percentages <- summary_by_rep %>%
  group_by(Feature, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Count = mean(Count),
    Avg_Percent = mean(Percent),
    SD_Percent = sd(Percent),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Avg_Percent))
```

Plot stacked bar chart
```{r}
# Ensure Feature is ordered by abundance (largest to smallest)
avg_percentages$Feature <- factor(avg_percentages$Feature, 
                                  levels = avg_percentages$Feature[order(avg_percentages$Avg_Percent, decreasing = TRUE)])

# Create stacked bar chart (single bar for average across replicates)
ggplot(avg_percentages, aes(x = Species, y = Avg_Percent, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", size = 0.5, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Avg_Percent, 1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("piRNA" = "#F0E442", 
                              "rRNA" = "#009E73", 
                              "tRNA" = "#E69F00", 
                              "miRNA" = "#56B4E9")) +
  labs(title = "Acropora hyacinthus Sperm Small RNA Composition",
       subtitle = "Average percentages across biological replicates",
       x = "", y = "Percentage (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Small RNA Class"))
```

```{r}
# Order features by abundance (largest first)
avg_percentages$Feature <- factor(avg_percentages$Feature, 
                                  levels = avg_percentages$Feature[order(avg_percentages$Avg_Percent, decreasing = TRUE)])

# Make miRNA stand out with brighter color + annotation
ggplot(avg_percentages, aes(x = Species, y = Avg_Percent, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "black", 
           position = position_stack(reverse = FALSE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("piRNA" = "#F0E442",      # Yellow - dominant
                              "rRNA" = "#009E73",       # Green
                              "tRNA" = "#E69F00",       # Orange
                              "miRNA" = "#D55E00"),     # Bright red - makes miRNA POP!
                   guide = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10), limits = c(0, 105)) +
  ylab("Percentage (%)") +
  xlab("") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" ", "\n", x)) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE))

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)   # install.packages("patchwork") if needed

# Order factors
avg_percentages$Feature <- factor(
  avg_percentages$Feature,
  levels = avg_percentages$Feature[order(avg_percentages$Avg_Percent, decreasing = TRUE)]
)

# Main stacked bar (0–100%)
p_main <- ggplot(avg_percentages,
                 aes(x = "Acropora\nhyacinthus", y = Avg_Percent, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "black", position = position_stack(reverse = T)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("piRNA" = "#F0E442",
                               "rRNA" = "#009E73",
                               "tRNA" = "#E69F00",
                               "miRNA" = "#D55E00")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
  ylab("Mapping percentage (%)") + xlab("") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm")); p_main

# Inset: zoom into 0–10% so miRNA is visible
p_inset <- ggplot(avg_percentages,
                  aes(x = "Acropora\nhyacinthus", y = Avg_Percent, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("piRNA" = "#F0E442",
                               "rRNA" = "#009E73",
                               "tRNA" = "#E69F00",
                               "miRNA" = "#D55E00"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 18),
                     breaks = seq(0, 18, 2)) +
  ylab("") + xlab("") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.5, fill = "white"))

# Combine with inset in top-right corner
p_combined <- p_main +
  inset_element(
    p_inset,
    left   = 0.30,  # narrower, centered
    right  = 0.70,
    bottom = 0.80,  # push inset to top
    top    = 1.10,
    align_to = "panel"
  );p_combined
```

Some other plot options: 

Log scale bar plot
```{r}
ggplot(avg_percentages,
       aes(x = Species, y = Avg_Count, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
           width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(piRNA = "#B25D91FF",
                               rRNA  = "#EFC7E6FF",
                               tRNA  = "#1BB6AFFF",
                               miRNA = "#172869FF")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" ", "\n", x)) +
  ylab("Average read count") +
  xlab("") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  #scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic()
```

Separate bar for miRNA
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

collapsed <- avg_percentages %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(Feature == "miRNA", "miRNA", "Other small RNAs")) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Percent = sum(Avg_Percent), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(collapsed, aes(x = "", y = Avg_Percent, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Avg_Percent, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 5) +
  coord_flip() +
  ylab("Percentage (%)") + xlab("") +
  theme_classic()

```

Points of percentages
```{r}
ggplot(avg_percentages, aes(x = Feature, y = Avg_Percent, color = Feature)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Avg_Percent, 1), "%")),
            vjust = -0.7, size = 3.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(piRNA="#F0E442", rRNA="#009E73",
                                tRNA="#E69F00", miRNA="#D55E00")) +
  ylab("Average percentage (%)") + xlab("") +
  theme_classic()

```

Two panel fig
```{r}
small <- avg_percentages %>% filter(Avg_Percent < 10)

ggplot(small, aes(x = Feature, y = Avg_Percent, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Avg_Percent, 2), "%")),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(piRNA="#F0E442", rRNA="#009E73",
                               tRNA="#E69F00", miRNA="#D55E00")) +
  ylim(0, 10) +
  ylab("Average percentage (%)") + xlab("") +
  theme_classic()

```

RPM calculations 
```{r}
rpm <- mapping %>%
  group_by(Replicate) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_reads = sum(Count),                 # total mapped small RNAs per replicate
    RPM        = Count / (Total_reads / 1e6)  # Reads per million
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
avg_rpm <- rpm %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_RPM = mean(RPM),
    SD_RPM  = sd(RPM),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(avg_rpm, aes(x = Feature, y = Avg_RPM, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(piRNA="#F0E442", rRNA="#009E73",
                               tRNA="#E69F00", miRNA="#D55E00")) +
  ylab("Average RPM (log10)") + xlab("") +
  theme_classic()
```
